scientific_question: In the supplied compressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence snapshot, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the spatial association between density and magnetic-field magnitude. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Measure association by the volume-weighted Pearson correlation. Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume. Report the numerical association coefficient.
